Add a case when a skill is rewritten. Cases that expected a skill archived on 2026-10-01 were removed; add one back when a live skill clearly owns the prompt. A negative case has an empty expect list and a forbid list: it is a hit when no forbidden skill fires, and only a forbidden skill counts as a false fire.
